text: 10月9日资金净流出TOP20榜单中，行业主题品种占据6席，债券类ETF占据4席，策略风格4只产品上榜，宽基品种3只产品上榜，货币类2只产品上榜，港股方向1只产品上榜，流出端整体规模有限。 信用类债券品种方面，科创债ETF嘉实（159600）单日净流出18.95亿元，规模422.53亿元，居全市场净流出首位；科创债ETF银华（159112）净流出2.51亿元，规模284.34亿元，2只科创债产品合计净流出约31.46亿元，超过信用债指数ETF大类17.64亿元的净流出规模，显示信用类品种内部其余品种获得资金流入。利率债方向2只产品上榜：国债政金债ETF招
text_en: In the top 20 list of net fund outflows on October 9, industry-themed products occupied 6 seats, bond ETFs occupied 4 seats, 4 strategy-style products made the list, 3 broad-based products made the list, 2 money market products made the list, and 1 Hong Kong stock direction product made the list. The overall scale of outflows was limited. In credit bond products, CCB CSI AAA Science and Technology Innovation Bond ETF Jiashi (159600) had a single-day net outflow of RMB 1.895 billion, with a scale of RMB 42.253 billion, ranking first in net outflows across the market; CCB CSI AAA Science and Technology Innovation Bond ETF Yinhua (159112) had a net outflow of RMB 251 million, with a scale of RMB 28.434 billion. The two science and technology innovation bond products had total net outflows of about RMB 3.146 billion, exceeding the RMB 1.764 billion net outflow scale of the credit bond index ETF category, indicating that other products within credit products received inflows. Two products in the interest rate bond direction made the list: Treasury bond policy financial bond ETF Zhao
